Subject: Initial ask: SOC 2 Type II report, audit period & secure share options

Hi Maya / Kevin,

Hope you’re well — Ethan from Redwood Inference (Customer Security & Trust). We’re preparing to onboard BrightCloud as part of a security review and wanted to share our SOC 2 Type II materials and confirm the audit window that’s relevant for your review. Quick summary of what we can provide and choices for transfer: 

- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent period ending 2026-06-30)
- Bridge letter template (if you need coverage for a later cutoff)
- SIG Lite and CAIQ (we can provide completed exports)
- Telemetry/retention sample logs (redacted) and configuration snapshots on request

Please confirm the specific audit period you expect (e.g., 12-month period ending 2026-06-30 vs. alternative window). Also let us know if you prefer: 1) a presigned S3 bundle (expires in 7 days), 2) Box shared folder with restricted access, or 3) a DocuSign exchange for the bridge letter + attestation workflow.

I’ve attached a bridge-letter template and a short presigned-transfer instruction doc. If helpful, below are two one-line reply templates you can use with your procurement/audit team: 

- "Please send the SOC 2 Type II report for the 12-month period ending 2026-06-30 and the bridge letter if needed."
- "We accept a presigned S3 bundle or Box invite; please provide the link and the expected expiration time."

Next steps: confirm audit window + preferred transfer method and I'll initiate the share and provide a minimal evidence list tailored to your needs.

Thanks,

Ethan Park

From: Maya Singh <m.singh@brightcloud.com>

Date: 2026-09-02T10:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Initial ask: SOC 2 Type II report, audit period & secure share options

Hi Ethan — thanks for the quick note.

A few clarifying points from our side: 

1) Audit period: our security & procurement teams normally request the 12-month period most recently attested; the period ending 2026-06-30 works. If you can provide a bridge letter that explains coverage until an upcoming attestation, that helps when the report is older than 90 days.

2) Evidence scope: in addition to the report and bridge letter we’ll likely ask for the following (we can trim if needed): 
  - SOC 2 report (pdf) and any management response
  - Bridge letter (if you have one signed)
  - SIG Lite export and CAIQ summary
  - Screenshot or short video of Azure/GCP console settings for logging (redacted)
  - Example retention policy documents and access control policy snippets (pdf)

3) Transfer: presigned S3 is acceptable. Please include a clear expiration and the MD5 checksums if possible. We also may need the auditor (Kevin) to have read-only access; CC’ing Kevin for availability.

Can you send the presigned link and a minimal manifest (list of filenames + checksums) so our team can triage? If you prefer DocuSign for the bridge letter, include the template and we’ll route to our legal.

Thanks — Maya
Maya Singh
Director, Information Security
BrightCloud Inc.
m.singh@brightcloud.com
